scope: Frozen protocol and implementation before full12seed experiment

findings.finding: Verifier accepted incomplete hash inventories or wrong declared policy
findings.resolution: Require exact config and configuration hash, input/claim hashes, complete artifact inventory, normalized source provenance and expected incomplete flags

findings.finding: Availability/last_checked checks did not verify last_verdict or state category
findings.resolution: Check last_verdict, last_supported, basis and compatible state category; rehashed semantic tamper regression

findings.finding: Scheduled body/restore/delete operations may leave source unchanged
findings.resolution: Save actual Git trees and changed_paths; report effective_change separately

findings.finding: Verifier failure skipped remaining variants within seed
findings.resolution: Per-variant exception recording and continuation; initial not_run statuses; injected failure test proves other variants execute

oracle_limits: Separate implementation uses stdlib tokenize and compile-only syntax check; shared CPython syntax dependency, not independent human authorship
